answer: Bonded identity with fraud bounties makes Sybils pay. One: a new agent locks a 500 POA bond vesting after eight honest epochs, so identity costs capital. Two: each epoch the agent solves a fresh puzzle seeded by that epoch, work no farm can split. Three: peer audits compare hardware fingerprints, and proving two identities share one controller slashes both bonds, half to the auditor. A 1,000-Sybil farm locks 500,000 POA plus devices, and one slip burns the cluster. Honest agents feel a quiet vault of trust, like a plume of smoke from one fire, while a whisper of mirrors rises from none.
